tools.name: render_pdf
tools.description: Turn a Markdown document into a PDF and return the PDF. Each successful render counts as one document. Re-sending the same document with the same idempotency key returns the same PDF and is not counted again.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: How many of the account's documents for the period are used: the period's dates, the number of documents included, the number used, the plan's limits, and the split by API key. Pass period to read an earlier period.

tools.name: get_template_format
tools.description: The full reference of the template document: page, paragraphs, styles, fields and formats, formulas and their functions, repeated blocks, tables, bands, placed items, graphics and barcode types, the grid, fonts and limits, and the starter templates. Read it before you write or change a template body

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: The account's saved templates: the id, the name, the revision, and the fields each one reads (data paths, CSV table sources and JSON list sources), and how many templates the plan keeps.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: One template: its editor document (body), its revision and the fields it reads. Change the body and send it to update_template with this revision. get_template_format describes the body.

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Save a new template. Send exactly one of body (an editor document), markdown, html or starter. In Markdown and HTML, write {{path}} where a value from the data goes; headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code and tables become editable blocks, and images and scripts are left out (left lists them). tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Change a template. Send base_revision, the revision you read; a newer revision answers template_version_conflict. What you leave out stays as it was: send body, markdown or html to replace the document, name to rename it.

tools.name: delete_template
tools.description: Delete a template with its images. Renders that name it answer not_found at once. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: preview_template
tools.description: Pictures of a saved template's pages filled with data, to check how it looks before render_template. It does not count as a document and nothing is stored. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_template · Private data: render_pdf, get_usage, get_template_format, get_template, create_template, update_template, preview_template, render_template · Public sink: get_template, create_template, update_template, preview_template · Destructive: get_template_format, delete_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_template · Private data: render_pdf, get_usage, get_template_format, get_template, create_template, update_template, preview_template, render_template · Public sink: get_template, create_template, update_template, preview_template · Destructive: get_template_format, delete_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_template_format" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
